title: Genesis Block Wallet Puzzle

author.name: anonymous (on-chain only, OP_RETURN messages to the escrow)

prize.note: 117 P2WSH outputs to one witness script at the sweep; the jackpot grew from 20,000 sats (2026-08-22) to 946,540 sats (2026-10-17) because the author relayed every paid question into the escrow

addresses.label: main (P2WSH, witness program 4dae67a9872f1402109f9670276afc2c0758f895aafddcd089795771b7964833)
addresses.expected: 946540 sats in 117 outputs, swept on 2026-10-17 in block 971803

target_format: P2WSH v0; witness script OP_2 <keyA> <keyB> OP_2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG; both keys at m/48'/0'/1231006505'/2'/0/0 from one 12-word BIP39 mnemonic (entropy = first 128 bits of SHA-256 of the coinbase text's hex, cut -b 263-400 of the raw block hex) with passphrase Satoshi Nakamoto and a non-standard PBKDF2 count per cosigner, 181505 and 200913

derivation.summary: sha256 of the 138 lowercase hex characters of the coinbase text (cut -b 263-400 of the 570-character raw genesis block hex), first 32 hex digits as 128-bit entropy, 12 English BIP39 words, passphrase Satoshi Nakamoto, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 with 181505 rounds (18:15:05 UTC) for one cosigner and 200913 (2009/1/3) for the other, both keys at m/48'/0'/1231006505'/2'/0/0, 2-of-2 P2WSH; tools/verify_solution.py reproduces the escrow
derivation.certified_against: the BIP-173 P2WSH test vector, and a real 2-of-2 P2WSH spent in block 963629 (tx 47ded3504e855ce418e46eeca4694b55a623d1e23a8e3c83292abbcf9cee9f7a, input 0) whose revealed keys rebuild the script and hash to the spent address; private key 1 to the generator point; negative control against the escrow

difficulty_note: solved by a reader (Schum-io) after publication, not by me; the missing setting was a non-standard PBKDF2 iteration count on one 12-word mnemonic (181,505 and 200,913, the genesis time and date), so every sweep at the standard 2,048 rounds, mine included, could not reach the keys

solutions.answer: mnemonic scan amateur fit scrap light over fire flip cushion reject hurt ugly, passphrase Satoshi Nakamoto, PBKDF2 rounds 181505 and 200913, both keys at m/48'/0'/1231006505'/2'/0/0, 2-of-2 P2WSH
